entries.title: A White Heron
entries.author: Sarah Orne Jewett
source_documents: 2025 Grade 9 FAST ELA Reading Released Items
entries.notes: Official Grade 9 FAST released literary model. Use as a legal public-domain seed and as a benchmark for excerpt length, pointable evidence, and stem specificity. Official B.E.S.T. Grade 9 sample text. Use as a public-domain priority seed when the excerpt passes GOGI certification.

entries.title: Do People Need Small Talk to Be Happy?
entries.author: Stephanie Hayes
source_documents: 2025 Grade 9 FAST ELA Reading Released Items
entries.notes: Official FAST paired-informational reference. Use to model opposing-argument, central-idea, and vocabulary item design; rights limit reusable passage harvesting.

entries.title: Icarus and Daedalus
entries.author: Josephine Preston Peabody
source_documents: 2025 Grade 9 FAST ELA Reading Released Items
entries.notes: Official Grade 9 FAST myth/adaptation model. Strong priority seed for R.3.3 and literary-remediation passages when the source pattern is self-contained.
